metadata.note: 1986 European 911 Turbo 3.3 (930/66, 300 PS, without catalyst): an air-cooled flat six, one exhaust valve a cylinder, one KKK K27. Valve: 41.5 mm (replacement listings), 10 mm lift (estimate), about 280 deg seat to seat (estimate from 50 BBDC / 18 ATDC at 1 mm), written as one circle of its open area by count x min(pi d lift, pi d^2/4): the lift falls short of a quarter of the diameter, so 40.7 mm; open 280 / 720 = 0.3889. Each bank's heat exchanger is one flat body which three short branches from the ports enter in turn (Porsche's diagrams 202-10 and 202-05), not a 3-into-1 collector; written as the 959's, branches of 0.10 m into a pipe of 0.12 m between cylinders (118 mm apart), the left bank 1-2-3 and the right 4-5-6 (1 and 4 at the front, the auditor's recollection; reversed, only the branches' order changes), in firing order 1-6-2-4-3-5. The body's inside was not seen. The right bank's pipe crosses to the left (behind the engine, an owners' forum) and both join a J pipe into the turbine, standing to the left: from the bodies' ends about 0.60 m (left) and 1.18 m (right; diagrams 202-05 and 202-15), their difference the engine's width. The K27: its throat 36 mm, 0.08 m, and the one room of every turbine here, 0.12 m x 150 mm; the wastegate, its small silencer and outlet are not written. European, without catalyst (202-15): a short pipe (about 0.20 m) from the turbine into the rear transverse silencer (a body of about 0.74 m x 200 mm, 23 L) and two tails (about 0.30 m). Written so: the run after the turbine (1.24 m) and the box's volume (23.2 L, 7.0 times the displacement) are the car's estimates, and the box is shorter and wider (0.42 m x 265 mm, with the wool) and the pipe before it longer (0.52 m); the two tails as one of their combined area. Lengths are estimates from Porsche's diagrams, drawn at an angle (about +-25 %). Inner diameters: the branches 38 mm (the earlier 911 TURBO 3.3's value), the bodies and pipes 50 mm, the pipe after the turbine 60 mm and the tails 55 mm taken, times 1.14 (43, 57, 68 and 89 mm). The expansion chamber's size and place, the 1.14 and the 20 mm of wool were set by ear (K, 2026-11-22); the run after the turbine and the box's volume stay the car's estimates. Lengths are in steps of 0.02 m.
